spanish: Y lo tomó a campo de Tsófim, a cabeza de la Pisgá, y edificó siete altares, y subió toro y carnero en el altar.

findings.issue: Morphology is qal participle active (masculine plural), not a proper noun; “Tsófim” leaves the participle untranslated and closes it as a name.
“a” before “campo” supplies a preposition; the field is a construct noun with no preposition token.

notes: Person, number, the article on Pisgá, seven altars, and the later singular altar match the tokens.
